scope.visual_review: Reviewed all five dense contact sheets, native-resolution final encoded frames, and paired source/encoded 200% nearest-neighbor text/connector crops.
scope.numeric_review: Compared every decoded sample against a fresh headless Chrome source render at its exact frame timestamp. Full video decode during frame extraction produced no errors.
scope.audio_scope: No narration listening or runtime synchronization audit in this review. Checked measured WAV duration against encoded duration using parent metadata; parent handles narration synchronization and runtime QA.
scope.not_claimed: Not a frame-by-frame visual watch of every encoded frame; not forced alignment.
